Base editing beyond CRISPR cutting

Base editing changes a single DNA letter without cutting both strands of the double helix. Cytosine base editors convert C to T while adenine base editors convert A to G. The study reports editing efficiency above sixty percent in human cell lines with few off-target edits. pages.title: Recovery and rest days for runners
pages.text:
Recovery and rest days for runners

Rest days and sleep matter as much as the miles for avoiding injury. A marathon training plan builds weekly mileage slowly over sixteen to twenty weeks.
